  WHY: actionlint 1.7.12 rejects this line, so the required `quick / static-checks` check fails (run 44974187572) and blocks the merge; GitHub also cannot create the variable, so `|| 'true'` always wins and the documented `false` rollback can never be reached. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:132 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The same `${{ vars.GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED || 'true' }}` expression reads a configuration variable with the reserved `GITHUB_` prefix.
  WHY: The same actionlint failure names this line, so the required static-checks gate is red and the rollback switch can never be reached. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:142-143 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The jq filter `select(startswith(".github/ai/"))` in `_review_github_ai_grant_prepare` lets nested `.github/ai/...` grant paths through, and `scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py::_parse_granted_paths` then rejects the whole list because `_valid_granted_entry` requires `len(parts) == 3`.
  WHY: A trusted issue that lists both `.github/ai/x.json` and a nested path gets `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT phase=snapshot outcome=rejected paths=0` and an empty sidecar, so the review editor cannot write the granted file while implement still stages it; the prepare helper also logs `outcome=granted paths=N` for a list the snapshot rejects. Suggested fix: `select(test("^\\.github/ai/[^/]+$"))`.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:95-97 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The heal path uses the same over-broad `select(startswith(".github/ai/"))` jq filter when it writes `"${root}/github_ai_grants.json"`, so one nested entry invalidates the whole grant.
  WHY: The heal sandbox's frozen grant becomes empty and the heal editor cannot stage the granted `.github/ai/<file>` (it fails as "out of heal scope"), while `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:497-501` filters entry by entry and keeps the literal path; the three surfaces disagree. glm filed this under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION; the others filed it under CORRECTNESS.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:648-665, 852-855 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_scope` calls `enumerate_workspace(..., strict=True)` and `allowed()` without loading or passing the frozen grant, so the repro-transfer failure classifier treats plan-granted `.github/ai/` paths as out of scope.
  WHY: When repro transfer fails for another reason (e.g. a host-baseline mismatch), an edited granted path makes `cmd_scope` exit 42, and the heal is held as `out_of_heal_scope` instead of following the repro-transfer failure path.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:116-153 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `grant_dir` that `mktemp -d` creates is not removed on the early-return paths that follow it (identity_unavailable, meta_error, guard_error, grant_error, no_github_ai_grant/zero-grant).
  WHY: Temporary directories under `RUNNER_TEMP` leak and pile up on self-hosted runners that reuse it. Both reviewers rated it NIT (confidence 3 and 4); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:116 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `pipeline_login="$(gh api user --jq .login 2>/dev/null || true)"` has no timeout.
  WHY: A hung `gh` call blocks sandbox prepare until the runner timeout; a 30-second cap matches the `gh_helpers.sh` style. Rated NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised it only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:line 27 (also .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml line 132) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `vars.GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED` uses a `GITHUB_`-prefixed configuration variable name; actionlint 1.7.12 rejected both lines in the PR-head `quick / static-checks` run ("must not start with the GITHUB_ prefix").
  WHY: The required check is red, and the variable cannot be created, so `|| 'true'` always wins and the documented rollback cannot be used. Fix: keep the env key (plan line 191) and change only the variable it reads (e.g. `vars.AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED || 'true'`) in both workflows; then update the workflow comments, the README row, the changelog line, the agents.d Switch bullet, and tests/test_github_ai_plan_grant_write.py::test_workflows_forward_the_switch_with_default.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:`_review_github_ai_grant_prepare` jq filter (also scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh line 95) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `select(startswith(".github/ai/"))` passes nested paths that `build_automation_grant` (scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py lines 445-448) keeps; `_parse_granted_paths` requires `len(parts) == 3` for every entry, so one nested entry rejects the whole list.
  WHY: The snapshot logs `outcome=rejected paths=0`, the review and heal editors cannot write `.github/ai/x.json` while implement_commit_changes.sh stages it, and prepare logs `outcome=granted paths=2`. Fix: `select(test("^\\.github/ai/[^/]+$"))` in both files.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Put the behaviour behind the plan's default-on *_ENABLED switch ... Setting the switch to `false` must restore today's behaviour." Plan line 191: "Rollback: `GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED=false`."
  Expected change site: workflow-level `env:` lines in .github/workflows/implement.yml and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, plus the README.md and changelog.d/9920-github-ai-plan-grant-write.md rollback instructions.
  Evidence of absence: The only operator control is `vars.GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED`, which GitHub cannot create; no hunk gives a reachable way to set the switch to `false`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Hardening (2 related items): scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh `_review_github_ai_grant_prepare`: wrap `gh api user` as `timeout 30 gh api user --jq .login 2>/dev/null || true` (1 line); `rm -rf -- "${grant_dir}"` before the early returns that grant nothing (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Note: the reviewer does not count the Phase 5 ci.yml listing as a gap, because tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py's `test_*.py` catch-all already covers the new test file.
